description: "Chúng mình tham gia NASA Space Apps Challenge để thử thách bản thân, giải quyết bài toán thực tế về xây dựng mô hình huấn luyện phi hành gia nhí và tạo ra một giải pháp sáng tạo có tính ứng dụng cao
summary: My team need to build a training model for child astronauts by making comics. We need to solve the problem, come up with an idea that interested. Because an idea is the first step in a project.
details: My product is a book, that you read and understand it. It helps people that under 18 years old has more motivation. I want to spread the community spirit from the book to them. I used Vietnamese language for the comic, chat gpt for tools. And I used comic content from us thought for my project. My project made a comic to everyone who like to be an astronauts can read it. My team considered to : content, creative and easy to understand for everyone.
dataRefs: NASA's public archive of space biology and astronaut health research, including studies on how spaceflight affects bone density, muscle mass, immune response, sleep, and more across many organisms. Searchable by keyword, making it well suited for tools that want to surface real published NASA science relevant to human health trade-offs in space.
